title: verify() returns Ok(VerificationResult) with per-signer results; Err only for outer DER parse failure
description: verify() returns Err only if the outer ContentInfo/SignedData DER cannot be parsed at all. Per-signer failures (bad digest, bad signature, cert chain failure, missing cert) are captured inside SignerResult.verified=false and SignerResult.error. A future contributor might suggest returning Err(SmimeError::SignatureVerification) when any signer fails, to make the common case simpler. That would be wrong: CMS allows multiple independent signers, and a caller must be able to check whether at least one trusted signer verified. Collapsing all signer failures into a top-level Err discards the per-signer detail needed to show 'signed by Alice (valid), signed by Bob (cert expired)'.
